title: Bloodline of Fate
next_chapter_hook: A resolute light burned in Su Qingyao's eyes as she slowly raised her right hand, golden runes condensing at her fingertips—a price that only one bearing the Bloodline of the Fate Scribe could bear.

text.content: The lingering chill from the rift had not yet dissipated. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm slightly scalding. The dimensional visitor's pressure moments ago had far exceeded his expectations, as if an invisible eye was piercing through the endless Void to observe him, causing fine beads of cold sweat to form on his back. 'The Day of Purification...' he murmured, repeating this prophecy while rapidly calculating possible variables in his mind, yet feeling that one crucial element remained missing. The wind swept across the ruins, stirring his disheveled hair and bringing with it a familiar footsteps sound.

dialogue.content: You're being stubborn again.

text.content: Su Qingyao's figure emerged from the night darkness, the white robe of an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow fluttering in the wind. Her steps were steady, yet her brow furrowed slightly at the sight of Chen Ji's disheveled state. Three days of pursuit had finally led her to find him in these ruins, only to discover that his condition was far worse than she had imagined. Without saying much, she simply retrieved a lustrous Elixir from her sleeve, walked directly to Chen Ji, and held it before his eyes. Moonlight fell upon her cold features, yet couldn't conceal the fleeting worry that flickered in the depths of her gaze.

dialogue.content: Take this first. Your Heavenly Fate Value is in such chaos—it's the price of using the Tianji Record, isn't it? Don't think I haven't noticed. Every time you use that ability, your complexion turns paler by three shades.

text.content: Chen Ji accepted the Elixir but didn't immediately consume it. He gazed up at Su Qingyao, her features appearing especially distinct in the moonlight—the sword-like brows like ink, frost-like eyes, straight nose, yet her lips pressed tight as if countless words were trapped in her throat. He suddenly recalled what Mo Xiansheng had said: that those who possessed the Tianji Record often overlooked the most obvious clues right beside them. Now, could those words hold deeper meaning? 'Senior Su,' he began, his voice hoarse from weakness, 'You pursued me for three days and nights. Aren't you afraid I might just be bait?'

dialogue.content: Afraid? If Su Qingyao were someone who feared death, I wouldn't have pursued alone into these Forbidden Grounds ruins. It's you I'm curious about, Chen Ji—or should I call you by another name? Every time you think you've deceived me, I find myself wondering: how many more secrets are you hiding?

text.content: Before her words could finish, an eerie tremor suddenly emanated from deep within the ruins. Golden cracks spread across the ground like living things, eventually converging beneath Su Qingyao's feet. In that instant, the Jade Pendant at her waist shattered, and an ancient, majestic aura burst forth from within her. Su Qingyao clutched her chest, her face contorted in agony, yet the next moment her eyes flew wide open—within her pupils, rows of minuscule golden runes floated like living creatures, ceaselessly shifting.

dialogue.content: What... is this... Chen Ji, I see... I see a name! On a massive scroll... it reads... Su... Su Qingyao?!

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm trembled violently, as if sensing something. He struggled to rise, stumbled forward two steps to Su Qingyao, and grabbed her wrist. The touch seared like a branding iron, yet the aura flowing within her made him freeze—the power was of the same origin and root as the Tianji Record, yet subtly different. As if one was the writer, while the other was... the echo of Fate itself.

dialogue.content: ...Finally awakened, have you? Descendant of the Fate Scribe.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted forth from the first page of the Tianji Record, his aged face displaying complex emotions. He gazed at Su Qingyao, his eyes holding both relief and worry. 'After the great catastrophe ten thousand years ago, the lineage of the Fate Scribe did not perish, but hid itself within the mortal world.' His voice rang out slowly. 'This old one has been waiting, waiting for the opportunity to awaken her. Who would have thought... it would be you, this lad.'

dialogue.content: Fate Scribe? Mo Xiansheng, what do you mean? My background... I always thought I was merely an ordinary noble daughter, how could...

text.content: Mo Xiansheng let out a long sigh, his remnant soul drifting slightly. 'Ten thousand years ago, the Tianji Record was not the only prophetic divine artifact. Alongside it stood the Book of Fate—the supreme tome that chronicles the destinies of all beings beneath heaven.' His gaze fell upon Su Qingyao. 'And those who wield the pen to inscribe fate are the Fate Scribes. Their bloodline is innately attuned to the currents of destiny, and with the wielder of the Tianji Record... they were originally a complementary pair.'

dialogue.content: Yet throughout the ages, wielders of the Tianji Record have viewed the Fate Scribes as threats, because once your bloodline awakens, you can see through the blind spots of the Tianji Record—the futures that have been deliberately obscured. Chen Ji, do you understand what this means?

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer. His fingers remained gripping Su Qingyao's wrist, feeling the scorching, violent power rampaging within her. She was clearly enduring unimaginable agony, yet gritted her teeth without uttering a sound, gazing at him stubbornly with those eyes now filled with golden runes. In this moment, he suddenly recalled what Mo Xiansheng had said: what the Tianji Record most feared was never a powerful enemy, but... a companion of the same path.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's bloodline is going out of control and run amok. You must make a choice—

choices.text: Forcefully stabilize her bloodline with the Tianji Record
choices.description: Consume 15 points of Heavenly Fate Value, using the Tianji Record's power to forcibly suppress the rampaging fate force within her, which may cause backlash.
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily stabilize Su Qingyao's bloodline rampage
choices.risk_hint: Your body is already weak; forcefully wielding the Tianji Record may endanger your life

dialogue.content: Don't! You've already used the Tianji Record too many times. If you continue like this, you will...

text.content: Before her words could finish, Chen Ji had already pressed the Tianji Record Fragment against her Brow Center. Golden runes intertwined with golden runes, the two forces of shared

choices.text: Let Mo Xiansheng guide her to control her bloodline
choices.description: Please have Mo Xiansheng use his remnant soul's power to guide Su Qingyao in awakening her bloodline. The risk is relatively low, but it may expose more information to third parties.
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao's bloodline awakens successfully, revealing her hidden identity
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may take the opportunity to reveal more secrets of the Tianji Record

dialogue.content: ...Alright, I'll make an exception this once. Girl, close your eyes and focus. Imagine your consciousness as a flowing river, embrace those runes instead of resisting them.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted behind Su Qingyao, his palms hovering gently over her shoulders. A soft white light emanated from his body, slowly seeping into her form. Gradually, the runes that had been frantically darting across her pupils began to calm, like tamed fish, obediently swimming toward her brow center, converging into a clear pattern—a blooming green lotus.

choices.text: Trust that Su Qingyao can overcome this trial on her own
choices.description: Su Qingyao is a descendant of the Fate Writer; her bloodline awakening should be completed by herself. You only need to guard beside her.
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao successfully masters her bloodline, developing deeper trust and reliance on you
choices.risk_hint: If she loses control, the consequences will be unimaginable

dialogue.content: Chen Ji... do you... do you really believe I can do this?

text.content: Chen Ji released her wrist and stepped back, a faint smile curving his lips. "You are a descendant of the Fate Writer. Your ancestor from ten thousand years ago could hold the pen to write the destinies of all living beings. You have no reason to be unable to control your own bloodline." His voice was calm yet certain. "I'll be watching beside you. Nothing will go wrong."

The green lotus mark on Su Qingyao's brow center slowly faded. She opened her eyes, clarity restored to her gaze, but that golden undertone could never be erased. She looked down at her hands, feeling the unfamiliar yet seemingly innate power within her body. After a long while, she finally spoke. "So... this is what makes me different from others."

dialogue.content: Since childhood, I found I could see strange visions—things that hadn't happened yet. At first, I thought they were hallucinations. Later, I thought my cultivation had gone wrong. Then... I began researching the ancient texts of the Tianqing Sect and found some fragments about the 'Fate Writer.' But I never expected the truth to be this heavy.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul stood silent for a moment before speaking slowly. "Ten thousand years ago, the Tianji Record and the Book of Fate appeared simultaneously, each held by one of the two wisps of Heavenly Will. The holder of the Tianji Record was responsible for glimpsing Heavenly Secrets and laying out strategies for the world, while the Fate Writer was responsible for recording the destinies of those key figures in the book, so that Heaven could monitor them." His gaze fell on Su Qingyao. "Your ancestor was the seventh-ranked existence on that list at the time—the Green Lotus Chronicler, Su Qinglian."

dialogue.content: Su Qinglian... that is my ancestor? I remember this name. In the oldest records of the Tianqing Sect, I saw this name mentioned repeatedly, but no one ever explained who she was. She... what kind of person was she?

text.content: Mo Xiansheng sighed, his remnant soul fading slightly. "She was the only one who opposed the Heavenly Purge plan." His voice was low and slow, as if unveiling a long-sealed taboo. "The catastrophe ten thousand years ago began when the Eye of Heaven decided to purge all 'unnecessary' variables. Su Qinglian risked being erased by Heaven to erase the names of those variables from the Book of Fate, thereby preserving their chances of survival—including the first holder of the Tianji Record."

dialogue.content: So... my ancestor betrayed Heaven to protect others? Does that mean... I, who inherited her bloodline, also...

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly stepped forward, interrupting her. "It means that from the moment you were born, you have been marked by the Eye of Heaven." His voice was soft, yet carried an undeniable certainty. "The dimensional visitors said the day of purging is approaching. I suspect they intend to purge descendants of variables like you." He paused, a sharp glint flickering in his eyes. "Or rather—everyone who might interfere with their chess game."

choice.prompt: The truth has been revealed. How will you respond?

choices.text: Propose an alliance to fight against Heaven together
choices.description: Su Qingyao's bloodline complements your Tianji Record. The two of you joining forces might break the Eye of Heaven's chess game.
choices.visible_reward: Establishing a Destined Community with Su Qingyao greatly increases the odds of victory
choices.risk_hint: The Destined Community will bind you together in shared fortune and shared ruin

dialogue.content: Alliance? Are you serious? I am a 'Cleansing Target' in the eyes of the Heavenly Dao. Getting too close to me will only bring you greater trouble.

text.content: Chen Ji let out a light laugh, the expression carrying both playfulness and seriousness. "Senior Su, do you think my years of playing weak were for nothing?" He raised his hand, his fingertip gently touching her Brow Center—the exact spot where the Green Lotus Mark had appeared moments ago. "I have been manipulating the world, simply to overturn this chessboard one day. You are a variable, and am I not? Two variables combined are always better than fighting alone."

choices.text: Warning her to stay away for her safety
choices.description: You carry too many secrets and dangers. I do not want to implicate Su Qingyao, hoping she can step away.
choices.visible_cost: Risk of losing an important ally
choices.visible_reward: Ensuring Su Qingyao's safety from being implicated, her security guaranteed
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may become disappointed in you, creating rifts in your relationship

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, what do you mean by this? Do you think I am someone who fears death? Or do you believe Su Qingyao only deserves to hide behind you?

text.content: Su Qingyao's voice rose sharply, the Green Lotus Mark at her Brow Center faintly flickering. She stepped forward, staring directly into Chen Ji's eyes. "I chased you for three days and three nights, from Tianqing Sect to these ruins—for what? You think I was just curious about what secrets you were hiding?"

choices.text: Using the Tianji Record to peer into her related future
choices.description: Employing the Tianji Record to examine Su Qingyao's position in future destiny, determining whether she is foe or ally
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining crucial intelligence regarding Su Qingyao
choices.risk_hint: Each use of the Tianji Record consumes Heavenly Fate, and the future visions become blurred due to her presence

dialogue.content: You are... using the Tianji Record to observe me?

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment unfolded in his palm, golden runes flowing ceaselessly. However, what caused Chen Ji's brow to furrow was that those future visions, which should have been clear, now rippled like reflections in disturbed water, as if an invisible hand was churning the river of destiny. He could only make out fragments—Su Qingyao standing upon some altar, surrounded by golden chains, the Green Lotus Mark at her Brow Center blazing like the scorching sun.

The Tianji Record's vision shattered before Chen Ji's eyes, yet it left an indelible impression—that figure entwined with golden chains. Su Qingyao seemed to sense something, the Green Lotus Mark at her Brow Center trembling slightly. "What did you see?" she asked softly, her tone calm yet carrying an unnoticeable tension. Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, tucking the Tianji Record back into his sleeve, raising his eyes to meet hers. Under the moonlight, his face half bright and half shadowed, his expression unreadable. "I saw some... interesting things."

dialogue.content: Interesting? You always do this, speaking only half your words, keeping people guessing anxiously. Chen Ji, we have known each other for some time now. Can you not be more candid with me?

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of self-mockery yet also release. "Candid?" he repeated the word, his voice low. "Senior Su, do you know why I have survived until now? Because I never trust anyone, and never am candid with anyone." He paused, then shifted topics. "But today, I can make an exception."

dialogue.content: Exception? You, Chen Ji, actually have exceptions?

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer directly but instead took a Jade Slip from his sleeve and handed it to Su Qingyao. "This is all the intelligence I have compiled over these years regarding the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, including the origin of dimensional arrivals, the possible timing of Cleansing Day, and..." he lowered his voice, "the possible location of the complete Tianji Record." Su Qingyao took the Jade Slip, and the moment her fingertips touched the warm jade, a strange resonance traveled from her palm, as if this Jade Slip had always belonged to her. Mo Xiansheng stroked his beard beside them with a knowing smile, "Good lad, I thought you would keep everything hidden forever."

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao is about to make a decisive choice—

choices.text: Accept her joining and establish a Destined Community
choices.description: Su Qingyao volunteered to become the key variable in your third path, sharing the weight of destiny with you.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the blessing of the Destiny Writer bloodline, with a significant enhancement to foresight abilities
choices.risk_hint: Once bound as a共同体 of shared destiny, life, death, fortune and misfortune will be completely intertwined

dialogue.content: This is the first vision I saw after my bloodline awakened—you standing before the complete Tianji Record, surrounded by countless golden threads, those threads' other ends... connected to the fate of all living things. And I stand beside you.

text.content: Su Qingyao raised her right hand, a golden rune condensing at her fingertip, that rune resonating with the text on the Tianji Record Fragment as if twins separated for years finally reunited. "Chen Ji, I, Su Qingyao, swear today by the Destiny Writer bloodline—I am willing to share Heavenly Fate with you, face life and death together, and carve out that fourth possibility!"

choices.text: Reject her sacrifice, seek another way to break the局
choices.description: Su Qingyao's bloodline is too precious, you cannot bear to involve her in this chess game at the cost of her destiny.
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao's safety is guaranteed, preserving the Destiny Writer bloodline as this trump card
choices.risk_hint: Without her bloodline assistance, the difficulty of breaking the局 will greatly increase

dialogue.content: Are you pushing me away again? Chen Ji, do you even see me as someone you can fight alongside?

text.content: Su Qingyao's voice echoed in the night wind, carrying irrepressible disappointment. She stepped forward, grabbing Chen Ji's collar and pulling him toward her, the distance between them so close they could almost feel each other's breath. "You think bearing everything alone is protecting me? You think keeping me out means I'll be safe? You're too naive!"

choices.text: Propose conditions, letting her assist as a guest
choices.description: Not fully accepting her joining, but allowing her to assist your actions in a non-bound way.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to obtain full bloodline blessing
choices.visible_reward: Maintain certain independence, preserving room for future choices
choices.risk_hint: An ambiguous relationship may leave both parties feeling uneasy

dialogue.content: A guest? Chen Ji, are you drawing a line between us?

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, a meaningful smile curving his lips. "Not drawing a line—leaving myself a way out." His voice was low and calm. "Senior Su, after arranging strategies under heaven for so many years, I never do anything without an escape route. The matter between you and me cannot be decided now—it must wait until the day of cleansing truly arrives, until I see all the variables clearly, before I can make a choice."

The night wind grew cool, dispersing the dark clouds above the ruins. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly within the Tianji Record Fragment, as if sensing something. "Little one, your choice... the old man has noted it." His voice was aged and profound. "Whatever decision you make, don't forget—the Tianji Record's mission was never to predict the future, but to rewrite destiny. Your 'third path'... perhaps lies within this single thought." With that, his figure slowly dissipated, leaving only a faint golden glow lingering in the air. Su Qingyao gazed toward where Mo Xiansheng vanished, lost in thought. "He seems... to be expecting something."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, when my bloodline awakened just now, besides seeing that name on the book of destiny... I also saw another scene.

text.content: Chen Ji's footsteps halted, and he turned to look at her. Under the moonlight, Su Qingyao's features appeared especially serious, the blue lotus mark between her brows faintly visible, emanating a soft glow. She took a deep breath, seemingly choosing her words carefully. "I saw... an altar, very high, so high it seemed it could pierce through the celestial dome. Above the altar stood a person—I couldn't see his face clearly, but I could sense he is the mastermind behind all of this."

dialogue.content: And at that person's feet, there were three paths—the first path had a blurry figure on it, one that looked like you yet wasn't entirely you; the second path was filled with people in black robes, their numbers constantly increasing; the third path... was empty. Nothing at all.

text.content: Chen Ji listened quietly, a flash of sharp light flickering in his pupils. Three paths—the first was clearly the "reverse heaven and change fate" path he had been planning all along; the second might be the "cleansing path" laid out by the Eye of Heaven's Mandate; and the third... "empty"—did that mean there was a fourth possibility? An inexplicable excitement surged in his heart, as if he had grasped some crucial clue. "Senior Su, are you certain there's absolutely nothing on the third path? Not even a blade of grass, a speck of dust?"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao closed her eyes, striving to recall that hazy image. After a long while, she opened her eyes again, a hint of astonishment flickering within. "Your question... actually jogged my memory. At the end of the third path, it truly wasn't empty—there was a door. The door was left ajar, and a thread of faint light leaked through the crack. That light's color..."
"What color?"
"Golden. The same golden as the runes on the Tianji Record. No, even more concentrated, purer... like solidified Heavenly Fate."

text.content: Chen Ji's breath grew slightly labored at this moment. Solidified Heavenly Fate—couldn't that mean the fourth possibility was... "Seizing the authority of Heaven?" His voice was low, carrying an incredulous tone. Su Qingyao shook her head, "I don't know. But if that door truly exists... perhaps it's worth trying." She raised her eyes toward the distant horizon, where the Tianqing Sect lay. "Regardless, before making a decision, I need to return to the sect first. The commotion from my bloodline awakening was too great—I'm afraid it has already alerted certain people."

Chen Ji nodded, his gaze deep and profound as an abyss. Once Su Qingyao's identity was exposed, it would inevitably draw the pursuit of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, and the interior of Tianqing Sect was not necessarily safe either—the shadow of the former Sect Master Ling Yuan still haunted his heart. But for now, he needed to give her an opportunity to express herself. "Senior Sister Su, let me escort you for a stretch." He spoke thus, drawing a small jade butterfly from his sleeve and gently placing it in her palm. "This is a piece I have positioned. If you face urgent danger, crush it, and I will arrive in the shortest time possible."

dialogue.content: "You've really given me quite a lot of things. Jade Slip, jade butterfly... and the intelligence about Heavenly Dao just now. Chen Ji, aren't you afraid I'll hand these things over to the sect and trade them for a glorious future?"

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, carrying within it an air of worldly unconcern. "If Senior Sister Su truly wished to harm me, there were plenty of opportunities—why wait until now?" His voice was casual, yet betrayed an unshakable certainty. "Moreover, you just swore before my eyes—a vow to share Heavenly Fate and face life and death together. That vow was witnessed by Heavenly Dao, Senior Sister Su wouldn't think you could just casually gloss over it?"

dialogue.content: "You... you're really shameless. It was clearly you who trapped me with words, yet in your mouth it becomes me taking the initiative to swear? Fine, fine, there's no winning an argument with you."

text.content: Su Qingyao glared at him irritably, yet ultimately did not protest. She carefully stored the Jade Slip and jade butterfly, then turned to walk toward the Tianqing Sect. After several steps, she suddenly halted and glanced back at Chen Ji. Beneath the moonlight, her face was cold as frost, yet hidden within her eyes was a sliver of warmth not easily察觉. "Chen Ji, remember what you said tonight. No matter what lies ahead, since I, Su Qingyao, have entered this chess game, I never intended to retreat unscathed."

When her words fell, her figure vanished into the night, leaving only a faint fragrance lingering in the air. Chen Ji gazed at the direction she departed, only收回ing his gaze after a long while. His palms felt faintly hot—the lingering resonance from the Tianji Record resonating with Su Qingyao's bloodline had not yet dissipated, as if something was quietly changing. He lowered his head to look at his own hands, his pupils reflecting the golden light of the Tianji Record Fragment. "Fate's Scribe..." he murmured to himself, "So the key to the fourth possibility has always been right beside me."

Night wind swept across the ruins, carrying a desolate chill. Chen Ji tucked the Tianji Record Fragment into his sleeve and turned to walk in the opposite direction. His pace was unhurried, yet imbued with a steady, unwavering strength. Su Qingyao's appearance had shown him new possibilities, but it also made him realize—the Eye of Heavenly Dao's布局 was far more profound than imagined. The warnings from the dimensional traveler, the prophecy of Shuffling Day, and that faintly discernible "door"... all clues pointed in one direction: the true decisive battle was approaching.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, if one day... we truly arrive at that door, will you push it open?"

text.content: Chen Ji stopped in his tracks but did not turn around. Moonlight stretched his shadow long, as if extending toward the edge of the heavens. He fell silent for a moment before speaking, his voice calm yet resolute: "Yes." Only one word, yet heavy as a thousand junns. Night wind howled past, stirring up boundless dust, shrouding both their silhouettes in a hazy mist. Su Qingyao gazed at his departing figure, the corners of her lips lifting slightly, revealing a meaningful smile. "Fool... that's exactly what I was waiting to hear."
